NASB.1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NASB.2: 'Take full vengeance for the sons of Israel on the Midianites; afterward you will be gathered to your people.'
NASB.3: Moses spoke to the people, saying, 'Arm men from among you for the war, that they may go against Midian to execute the LORD'S vengeance on Midian.
NASB.4: 'A thousand from each tribe of all the tribes of Israel you shall send to the war.'
NASB.5: So there were furnished from the thousands of Israel, a thousand from each tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
NASB.6: Moses sent them, a thousand from each tribe, to the war, and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war with them, and the holy vessels and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.
NASB.7: So they made war against Midian, just as the LORD had commanded Moses, and they killed every male.
NASB.8: They killed the kings of Midian along with the [rest of] their slain: Evi and Rekem and Zur and Hur and Reba, the five kings of Midian; they also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.
NASB.9: The sons of Israel captured the women of Midian and their little ones; and all their cattle and all their flocks and all their goods they plundered.
NASB.10: Then they burned all their cities where they lived and all their camps with fire.
NASB.11: They took all the spoil and all the prey, both of man and of beast.
NASB.12: They brought the captives and the prey and the spoil to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest and to the congregation of the sons of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan [opposite] Jericho.
NASB.13: Moses and Eleazar the priest and all the leaders of the congregation went out to meet them outside the camp.
NASB.14: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who had come from service in the war.
NASB.15: And Moses said to them, 'Have you spared all the women?
NASB.16: 'Behold, these caused the sons of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, so the plague was among the congregation of the LORD.
NASB.17: 'Now therefore, kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man intimately.
NASB.18: 'But all the girls who have not known man intimately, spare for yourselves.
NASB.19: 'And you, camp outside the camp seven days; whoever has killed any person and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves, you and your captives, on the third day and on the seventh day.
NASB.20: 'You shall purify for yourselves every garment and every article of leather and all the work of goats' [hair], and all articles of wood.'
NASB.21: Then Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who had gone to battle, 'This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded Moses:
NASB.22: only the gold and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin and the lead,
NASB.23: everything that can stand the fire, you shall pass through the fire, and it shall be clean, but it shall be purified with water for impurity. But whatever cannot stand the fire you shall pass through the water.
NASB.24: 'And you shall wash your clothes on the seventh day and be clean, and afterward you may enter the camp.'
NASB.25: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NASB.26: 'You and Eleazar the priest and the heads of the fathers' [households] of the congregation take a count of the booty that was captured, both of man and of animal;
NASB.27: and divide the booty between the warriors who went out to battle and all the congregation.
NASB.28: 'Levy a tax for the LORD from the men of war who went out to battle, one in five hundred of the persons and of the cattle and of the donkeys and of the sheep;
NASB.29: take it from their half and give it to Eleazar the priest, as an offering to the LORD.
NASB.30: 'From the sons of Israel's half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys and of the sheep, from all the animals, and give them to the Levites who keep charge of the tabernacle of the LORD.'
NASB.31: Moses and Eleazar the priest did just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NASB.32: Now the booty that remained from the spoil which the men of war had plundered was 675,000 sheep,
NASB.35: and of human beings, of the women who had not known man intimately, all the persons were 32,000.
NASB.36: The half, the portion of those who went out to war, was [as follows]: the number of sheep was 337,500,
NASB.37: and the LORD'S levy of the sheep was 675;
NASB.38: and the cattle were 36,000, from which the LORD'S levy was 72;
NASB.39: and the donkeys were 30,500, from which the LORD'S levy was 61;
NASB.40: and the human beings were 16,000, from whom the LORD'S levy was 32 persons.
NASB.41: Moses gave the levy [which was] the LORD'S offering to Eleazar the priest, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NASB.42: As for the sons of Israel's half, which Moses separated from the men who had gone to war--
NASB.43: now the congregation's half was 337,500 sheep,
NASB.47: and from the sons of Israel's half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animals, and gave them to the Levites, who kept charge of the tabernacle of the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NASB.48: Then the officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, approached Moses,
NASB.49: and they said to Moses, 'Your servants have taken a census of men of war who are in our charge, and no man of us is missing.
NASB.50: 'So we have brought as an offering to the LORD what each man found, articles of gold, armlets and bracelets, signet rings, earrings and necklaces, to make atonement for ourselves before the LORD.'
NASB.51: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from them, all kinds of wrought articles.
NASB.52: All the gold of the offering which they offered up to the LORD, from the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, was 16,750 shekels.
NASB.53: The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.
NASB.54: So Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it to the tent of meeting as a memorial for the sons of Israel before the LORD.

CSB17.2: “Execute vengeance for the Israelites against the Midianites. After that, you will be gathered to your people.” <sup>ⓛ</sup>
CSB17.3: So Moses spoke to the people, “Equip some of your men for war. They will go against Midian to inflict the LORD’s vengeance <sup>ⓜ</sup> on them.
CSB17.4: Send one thousand men to war from each Israelite tribe.”
CSB17.5: So one thousand were recruited from each Israelite tribe out of the thousands <sup>[1]</sup> in Israel — twelve thousand equipped for war.
CSB17.6: Moses sent one thousand from each tribe to war. They went with Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest, in whose care were the holy objects and signal trumpets.
CSB17.7: They waged war against Midian, as the LORD had commanded Moses, and killed every male. <sup>ⓝ</sup>
CSB17.8: Along with the others slain by them, they killed the Midianite kings — Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. <sup>ⓐ</sup> They also killed Balaam son of Beor <sup>ⓑ</sup> with the sword.
CSB17.9: The Israelites took the Midianite women and their dependents captive, and they plundered all their cattle, flocks, and property. <sup>ⓒ</sup>
CSB17.10: Then they burned all the cities where the Midianites lived, as well as all their encampments,
CSB17.11: and took away all the spoils of war and the captives, both people and animals.
CSB17.12: They brought the prisoners, animals, and spoils of war to Moses, the priest Eleazar, and the Israelite community at the camp on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.
CSB17.13: Moses, the priest Eleazar, and all the leaders of the community went to meet them outside the camp.
CSB17.14: But Moses became furious with the officers, the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, who were returning from the military campaign.
CSB17.15: “Have you let every female live?” he asked them.
CSB17.16: “Yet they are the ones who, at Balaam’s advice, incited the Israelites to unfaithfulness against the LORD in the Peor incident, so that the plague came against the LORD’s community. <sup>ⓓ</sup>
CSB17.17: So now, kill every male among the dependents and kill every woman who has gone to bed with a man, <sup>ⓔ</sup>
CSB17.18: but keep alive for yourselves all the young females who have not gone to bed with a man. <sup>ⓕ</sup>
CSB17.19: “You are to remain outside the camp for seven days. All of you and your prisoners who have killed a person or touched the dead are to purify yourselves on the third day and the seventh day. <sup>ⓖ</sup>
CSB17.20: Also purify everything: garments, leather goods, things made of goat hair, and every article of wood.” <sup>ⓗ</sup>
CSB17.21: Then the priest Eleazar said to the soldiers who had gone to battle, “This is the legal statute the LORD commanded Moses:
CSB17.22: The gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, and lead —
CSB17.23: everything that can withstand fire — you are to pass through fire, and it will be clean. It must still be purified with the purification water. <sup>ⓘ</sup> Anything that cannot withstand fire, pass through the water.
CSB17.24: On the seventh day wash your clothes, and you will be clean. <sup>ⓙ</sup> After that you may enter the camp.”
CSB17.26: “You, the priest Eleazar, and the family heads of the community are to take a count of what was captured, people and animals.
CSB17.27: Then divide the captives between the troops who went out to war and the entire community. <sup>ⓚ</sup>
CSB17.28: Set aside a tribute for the LORD from what belongs to the fighting men who went out to war: one out of every five hundred people, cattle, donkeys, sheep, and goats.
CSB17.29: Take the tribute from their half and give it to the priest Eleazar as a contribution to the LORD.
CSB17.30: From the Israelites’ half, take one out of every fifty from the people, cattle, donkeys, sheep, and goats, all the livestock, and give them to the Levites who perform the duties of <sup>[2]</sup> the LORD’s tabernacle.”
CSB17.31: So Moses and the priest Eleazar did as the LORD commanded Moses.
CSB17.32: The captives remaining from the plunder the army had taken totaled: 675,000 sheep and goats,
CSB17.35: and 32,000 people, all the females who had not gone to bed with a man.
CSB17.36: The half portion for those who went out to war numbered: 337,500 sheep and goats,
CSB17.37: and the tribute to the LORD was 675 from the sheep and goats;
CSB17.38: from the 36,000 cattle, the tribute to the LORD was 72;
CSB17.39: from the 30,500 donkeys, the tribute to the LORD was 61;
CSB17.40: and from the 16,000 people, the tribute to the LORD was 32 people.
CSB17.41: Moses gave the tribute to the priest Eleazar as a contribution for the LORD, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
CSB17.42: From the Israelites’ half, which Moses separated from the men who fought,
CSB17.43: the community’s half was: 337,500 sheep and goats,
CSB17.47: Moses took one out of every fifty, selected from the people and the livestock of the Israelites’ half. He gave them to the Levites who perform the duties of the LORD’s tabernacle, as the LORD had commanded him.
CSB17.48: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, approached Moses
CSB17.49: and told him, “Your servants have taken a census of the fighting men under our command, and not one of us is missing.
CSB17.50: So we have presented to the LORD an offering of the gold articles each man found — armlets, bracelets, rings, earrings, and necklaces — to make atonement for ourselves before the LORD.” <sup>ⓛ</sup>
CSB17.51: Moses and the priest Eleazar received from them all the articles made out of gold.
CSB17.52: All the gold of the contribution they offered to the LORD, from the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, was 420 pounds. <sup>[3]</sup>
CSB17.53: Each of the soldiers had taken plunder for himself. <sup>ⓜ</sup>
CSB17.54: Moses and the priest Eleazar received the gold from the commanders of thousands and of hundreds and brought it into the tent of meeting as a memorial for the Israelites before the LORD.

NLT.1: Then the LORD said to Moses,
NLT.2: “On behalf of the people of Israel, take revenge on the Midianites for leading them into idolatry. After that, you will die and join your ancestors.”
NLT.3: So Moses said to the people, “Choose some men, and arm them to fight the LORD’s war of revenge against Midian.
NLT.4: From each tribe of Israel, send 1,000 men into battle.”
NLT.5: So they chose 1,000 men from each tribe of Israel, a total of 12,000 men armed for battle.
NLT.6: Then Moses sent them out, 1,000 men from each tribe, and Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest led them into battle. They carried along the holy objects of the sanctuary and the trumpets for sounding the charge.
NLT.7: They attacked Midian as the LORD had commanded Moses, and they killed all the men.
NLT.8: All five of the Midianite kings — Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba — died in the battle. They also killed Balaam son of Beor with the sword.
NLT.9: Then the Israelite army captured the Midianite women and children and seized their cattle and flocks and all their wealth as plunder.
NLT.10: They burned all the towns and villages where the Midianites had lived.
NLT.11: After they had gathered the plunder and captives, both people and animals,
NLT.12: they brought them all to Moses and Eleazar the priest, and to the whole community of Israel, which was camped on the plains of Moab beside the Jordan River, across from Jericho.
NLT.13: Moses, Eleazar the priest, and all the leaders of the community went to meet them outside the camp.
NLT.14: But Moses was furious with all the generals and captains who had returned from the battle.
NLT.15: “Why have you let all the women live?” he demanded.
NLT.16: “These are the very ones who followed Balaam’s advice and caused the people of Israel to rebel against the LORD at Mount Peor. They are the ones who caused the plague to strike the LORD’s people.
NLT.17: So kill all the boys and all the women who have had intercourse with a man.
NLT.18: Only the young girls who are virgins may live; you may keep them for yourselves.
NLT.19: And all of you who have killed anyone or touched a dead body must stay outside the camp for seven days. You must purify yourselves and your captives on the third and seventh days.
NLT.20: Purify all your clothing, too, and everything made of leather, goat hair, or wood.”
NLT.21: Then Eleazar the priest said to the men who were in the battle, “The LORD has given Moses this legal requirement:
NLT.22: Anything made of gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, or lead —
NLT.23: that is, all metals that do not burn — must be passed through fire in order to be made ceremonially pure. These metal objects must then be further purified with the water of purification. But everything that burns must be purified by the water alone.
NLT.24: On the seventh day you must wash your clothes and be purified. Then you may return to the camp.”
NLT.25: And the LORD said to Moses,
NLT.26: “You and Eleazar the priest and the family leaders of each tribe are to make a list of all the plunder taken in the battle, including the people and animals.
NLT.27: Then divide the plunder into two parts, and give half to the men who fought the battle and half to the rest of the people.
NLT.28: From the army’s portion, first give the LORD his share of the plunder — one of every 500 of the prisoners and of the cattle, donkeys, sheep, and goats.
NLT.29: Give this share of the army’s half to Eleazar the priest as an offering to the LORD.
NLT.30: From the half that belongs to the people of Israel, take one of every fifty of the prisoners and of the cattle, donkeys, sheep, goats, and other animals. Give this share to the Levites, who are in charge of maintaining the LORD’s Tabernacle.”
NLT.31: So Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.
NLT.32: The plunder remaining from everything the fighting men had taken totaled 675,000 sheep and goats,
NLT.36: Half of the plunder was given to the fighting men. It totaled 337,500 sheep and goats,
NLT.37: of which 675 were the LORD’s share;
NLT.38: 36,000 cattle, of which 72 were the LORD’s share;
NLT.39: 30,500 donkeys, of which 61 were the LORD’s share;
NLT.40: and 16,000 virgin girls, of whom 32 were the LORD’s share.
NLT.41: Moses gave all the LORD’s share to Eleazar the priest, just as the LORD had directed him.
NLT.42: Half of the plunder belonged to the people of Israel, and Moses separated it from the half belonging to the fighting men.
NLT.47: From the half-share given to the people, Moses took one of every fifty prisoners and animals and gave them to the Levites, who maintained the LORD’s Tabernacle. All this was done as the LORD had commanded Moses.
NLT.48: Then all the generals and captains came to Moses
NLT.49: and said, “We, your servants, have accounted for all the men who went out to battle under our command; not one of us is missing!
NLT.50: So we are presenting the items of gold we captured as an offering to the LORD from our share of the plunder — armbands, bracelets, rings, earrings, and necklaces. This will purify our lives before the LORD and make us right with him. ”
NLT.51: So Moses and Eleazar the priest received the gold from all the military commanders — all kinds of jewelry and crafted objects.
NLT.52: In all, the gold that the generals and captains presented as a gift to the LORD weighed about 420 pounds.
NLT.53: All the fighting men had taken some of the plunder for themselves.
NLT.54: So Moses and Eleazar the priest accepted the gifts from the generals and captains and brought the gold to the Tabernacle as a reminder to the LORD that the people of Israel belong to him.

WEB.2: “Avenge the children of Israel for the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”
WEB.3: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for the war, that they may go against Midian, to execute Yahweh’s vengeance on Midian.
WEB.4: Of every tribe one thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, you shall send to the war.”
WEB.5: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
WEB.6: Moses sent them, one thousand of every tribe, to the war, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.
WEB.7: They fought against Midian, as Yahweh commanded Moses. They killed every male.
WEB.8: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.
WEB.9: The children of Israel took the women of Midian captive with their little ones; and all their livestock, all their flocks, and all their goods, they took as plunder.
WEB.10: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burned with fire.
WEB.11: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal.
WEB.12: They brought the captives, and the prey, and the plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.
WEB.13: Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went out to meet them outside of the camp.
WEB.14: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.
WEB.15: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?
WEB.16: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against Yahweh in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of Yahweh.
WEB.17: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.
WEB.18: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
WEB.19: “Encamp outside of the camp seven days. Whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.
WEB.20: As to every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood, you shall purify yourselves.”
WEB.21: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, “This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded Moses:
WEB.22: however the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
WEB.23: everything that may withstand the fire, you shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity. All that doesn’t withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water.
WEB.24: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp.”
WEB.26: “Count the plunder that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation;
WEB.27: and divide the plunder into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.
WEB.28: Levy a tribute to Yahweh of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred; of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks.
WEB.29: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for Yahweh’s wave offering.
WEB.30: Of the children of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the livestock, and give them to the Levites, who perform the duty of Yahweh’s tabernacle.”
WEB.31: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as Yahweh commanded Moses.
WEB.32: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,
WEB.33: and seventy-two thousand head of cattle,
WEB.35: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of the women who had not known man by lying with him.
WEB.36: The half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep:

WEB.41: Moses gave the tribute, which was Yahweh’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
WEB.42: Of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men who fought
WEB.43: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,
WEB.44: and thirty-six thousand head of cattle,
WEB.45: and thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,
WEB.47: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of Yahweh’s tabernacle; as Yahweh commanded Moses.
WEB.48: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses.
